input.title: Toasted Oat Porridge with Brown Butter Apples
instructionLines: Toast the rolled oats in a dry saucepan over medium heat for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
[Apples] Melt the butter in a small skillet until it foams and smells nutty.
[Apples] Add the diced apple, brown sugar, and cinnamon; cook 5 minutes until soft.
Pour the milk over the oats, add the salt, and simmer 6 minutes, stirring often.
Spoon into bowls and top with the brown butter apples.
input.rawText: Toasted Oat Porridge with Brown Butter Apples A cozy two-serving breakfast of toasted oats under brown butter apples.
